mechanism: Learn a feature-dependent prior support tilt by individual posterior taxi MSE through one fixed public measurement likelihood.
recommendation: One bounded source-only sensitivity gate is scientifically justified. Predictive headroom is unknown; gate success alone cannot authorize or select a candidate. Verify admissible training priors before implementing a learner.

novelty.search_scope: Existing 791-file frontier scan plus focused full source/report searches for aggregate loss, posterior-aware training, marginal likelihood, weak supervision, conditional density, and residual allocation; no implemented posterior-aware supervised support learner found. This is bounded evidence, not proof of global absence.

exact_overlap_exclusions.difference: That fits regularized airline/month logit shifts from public totals while priors and source likelihood stay fixed; candidate would fit row-feature tilts using individual allowed-training labels through the posterior objective. Merely leave-own-day-out or changing prior-odds shrinkage is closed.
They learn or calibrate binary/three-class/continuous prior targets before public conditioning. A posterior-MSE versus prior-MSE matched control isolates the proposed objective.
That replaces endpoint/support construction then reuses the existing likelihood. This design fixes every support location and measurement setting; only a shared input-dependent tilt could be learned.
Fixed disagreement allocation and heteroscedastic individual likelihood do not learn through the public posterior. They remain adverse evidence, not candidates to reopen.
Current day-donor context changes input representation while preserving individual MSE; no posterior layer or aggregate loss is trained.

novelty.not_proposed: No additional sum penalty, monthly-odds variant, exact source-total constraint, new covariance parameter, numerical posterior solver, or feature-width search.

measurement_contract.prior: Original source-blind v70 packet means and original fixed discrete supports; no current public-network prior may be treated as independent of the same public likelihood.
measurement_contract.sources: Retained local takeoff-day/runway truncated count and taxi sum plus once-estimated UTC off-block-day predeparture total; preserve each membership, source-count mismatch, shared-flight covariance, common-day term, fixed t5 and source calibration.
measurement_contract.cohort_warning: Existing feature cohorts and public populations/calendar are not identical. The original calibrated soft likelihood remains approximate; a learned layer does not remove source bias.
measurement_contract.routed_rows: Every peer contribution uses an admissible prediction/support. Never subtract matched/copy/routed true labels during training.
measurement_contract.one_likelihood: Each target sees the source likelihood once. A learned posterior component must replace its matched original component when transported to v80; do not append the same posterior again.
measurement_contract.calibration_scope: Use only saved allowed-outer-training calibration. No full-year calibration for Jan/Jul research; no fitting from held taxi labels.

source_only_gate.allowed_inputs: Exactly original 11-column labels-absent input packet, original two source tables, original fold parameter JSON, original frozen support/moment functions and retained posterior output for replay. No scored/CV truth parquet, no departure labels.
source_only_gate.population: All existing supported ambiguous Rome targets in both retained input months, reported by month and source day. Numerical gate population is fixed by original eligibility, not outcomes.
source_only_gate.fixed_tilt: For fixed support y_ij with weights w_ij and incoming mean mu_i, t_ij=(y_ij-mu_i)/max(gap_i-tau_fold,60); w_ij(theta) proportional to w_ij*exp(t_ij*x_i dot theta). theta=0 exactly recovers the prior.
source_only_gate.fixed_low_dimension: x=[1, log(gap/3600), logit(clip((prior-tau)/(gap-tau),1e-6,1-1e-6)), product of the preceding two nonconstant terms]. These four columns use only source-blind packet quantities and fixed transforms.
diagnostics: Authenticate packet/source/helper hashes to original identities and explicitly assert the 11 input names exclude labels.
Construct original fixed per-target peer mean/covariance and support log likelihood without calling a fitting routine; zero tilt must replay retained original posterior means.
Compute prior and posterior support variance, posterior mean movement, and exact derivative d posterior_mean / d theta = Cov_post(y,t)*x = Var_post(y)/scale*x.

Report finite-difference derivative agreement, prior/posterior variance ratios, nonzero-gradient counts and dates, singular values/rank of the four-column output Jacobian, with and without centering features within existing source cohorts.

Compute the source-moment Jacobian by summing Cov_prior(contribution,t)*x under the original membership matrices and whiten by the retained measurement covariance; report singular values and sensitivity to existing source-bias directions. This is source identifiability, not prediction quality.
Where airline/month data are unavailable in this packet, explicitly say that cohort centering does not prove orthogonality to every old airline/month-odds direction.
source_only_gate.interpretation: Zero/saturated sensitivities or a rank-deficient source operator identify poor feasibility; nonzero rank merely establishes trainability. Neither proves score gain, source-population validity, or independent information.
source_only_gate.execution: Root allocation required for real numerical gate. One thread, no GPU, no model fit, no mutation of active cohort source; retain full diagnostic artifacts and compact JSON.

possible_later_matched_screen.candidate: Same fixed small feature tilt, optimized by supervised posterior MSE on allowed training rows, with peer messages fixed from admissible out-of-fold predictions.
possible_later_matched_screen.control: Identical initialization, features, regularization, optimizer and updates; optimize prior MSE, then apply the same posterior once. Also retain zero-tilt original control.
possible_later_matched_screen.data_requirement: For each outer fold, training peer priors must exclude both outer-held months and their own inner evaluation labels. Source calibration, scalers and learned tilt must obey the corresponding train-only scopes.
possible_later_matched_screen.gate: Only a future frozen screen can use Jan/Jul taxi outcomes; both month improvements and paired upper bound below zero against actual v80 and matched objective control would be required. Existing development reuse remains explicit.
possible_later_matched_screen.compute: After admissible fixed likelihood/support packets exist, four-parameter optimization is cheap and needs no GPU; constructing valid full-cohort peer packets is the main cost. A genuinely joint end-to-end model can avoid two-stage in-sample-prior calibration but is a larger separate design.

availability.training_peer_packets: Not found in current selected joint caches; these only contain Jan/Jul held rows.
availability.current_outer_models: Prediction on their own allowed training rows is in-sample and is not an honest substitute for cross-fitted peer calibration.
availability.scope_limit: This is an explicit local check of selected caches and historical Rome calibration references, not an exhaustive assertion that no reusable admissible legacy model or prediction exists anywhere.

execution_so_far: Source/report reads, file existence checks and 26,528-row month-column metadata inventory only. No new taxi labels read, numerical gate, model fit, CV score, download, upload or active source edit.
